name: The Iron Crisis of Nashkel & The Deep Mines
campaignName: The Iron Crisis of Nashkel & The Deep Mines

nodes.name: Township of Nashkel
nodes.customNotes: A rustic frontier town nestled against the Cloud Peaks. Red banners of Amn hang from the garrison walls, but the streets are tense. Blacksmiths examine rusted daggers with despair while bounty hunters linger outside the inn doors.

nodes.name: North Nashkel Road & Farmland
nodes.customNotes: Rutted dirt highway flanked by dry wheat fields and irrigation trenches. An upturned cart sits abandoned near an eastern furrow where an Ankheg shell lies partially buried in the mud.

nodes.name: Great Cloud Peak Waterfall & Pass
nodes.customNotes: A deafening mountain cascade carving through sheer granite bluffs toward the carnival grounds. Stray winter wolves and gibberlings stalk the mist-slick ledges.

nodes.name: Nashkel Carnival Encampment
nodes.customNotes: Vibrant striped pavilion tents, fortune tellers, games of chance, and exotic animal cages providing a garish distraction from the regional economic collapse.

nodes.name: Upper Quarry & Sculpture Clearing
nodes.customNotes: A sun-baked limestone amphitheater littered with shattered marble blocks. The sculptor Prism feverishly carves the likeness of Queen Ellesime into a granite cliff-face while dreading the bounty hunter Greywolf.

nodes.name: Nashkel Mines Surface Camp
nodes.customNotes: The palisaded surface works of the iron mine. Ore carts sit idle, guarded by weary Amnian soldiers with bloodhounds. A gaping timber-reinforced adit leads down into pitch-black subterranean shafts.

nodes.name: The Nashkel Inn
nodes.customNotes: A sturdy timber-and-plaster roadside hostelry. Smells of roasted leek potage and stale ale. The assassin Neira waits inside with drawn daggers and hold person scrolls to ambush inquisitive parties.

nodes.name: Mayor Ghastkill's Adjudication Pavilion
nodes.customNotes: A raised wooden platform near the northern bridge where Mayor Berrun Ghastkill and Bounty Officer Oublek inspect incoming travelers and recruit armed investigations into the iron crisis.

nodes.name: Amnian Military Garrison
nodes.customNotes: Fortified stone barracks housing Captain Bardolan's border detachment. The barbarian Minsc paces the courtyard, pleading for stout swords to mount a rescue of Dynaheir from the Gnoll Stronghold.

nodes.name: Belching Dragon Tavern & Stone Bridge
nodes.customNotes: A low-ceilinged dive frequented by off-duty miners. Outside on the footbridge, the Thayvian wizard Edwin Odesseiron scans the crowd, offering coin for the death of Dynaheir.

nodes.name: Temple of Helm & Hallowed Grounds
nodes.customNotes: A stone sanctuary dedicated to the Vigilant One. Watcher Nalin offers healing, identifies enchanted weapons, and ministers to miners maddened by the contaminated iron ore.

nodes.name: Nashkel General Store & Silo
nodes.customNotes: The town's supply depot selling grain, missile ammunition, and general dungeoneering gear. The shopkeeper warns that iron blades snap under pressure due to the widespread rot.

nodes.name: Western Plowing Fields & Buried Cache
nodes.customNotes: Freshly turned crop fields. A sunken hollow along the tree line conceals a hidden cache containing a set of masterwork Ankheg Plate Mail.

nodes.name: Quarry Perimeter Road
nodes.customNotes: The rutted mountain approach leading from the Cloud Peak foothills into the quarry bowl. Warning signs posted by the Amnian Council caution against trespassers.

nodes.name: Amnian Guard Palisade
nodes.customNotes: Timber stockade manned by nervous Amnian border guards under orders to shoot looters on sight and keep panicked miners from fleeing back north.

nodes.name: Open-Cast Excavation Pit
nodes.customNotes: Terraced rock faces where surface miners quarry slate and iron-bearing schist. Rusted pickaxes and shattered iron sledgehammers lie heaped beside abandoned wheelbarrows.

nodes.name: Smelter Yard & Ore Wagons
nodes.customNotes: Cold charcoal kilns and stacked crates of brittle iron ingots. Guard dogs growl at shadows as workers whisper of demonic laughter echoing up the shafts at midnight.

nodes.name: Main Pithead Timber Adit
nodes.customNotes: The reinforced timber entrance opening into the subterranean Nashkel Mine complex. Dank air smelling of sulphur, wet rock, and goblin grease wafts from the dark opening leading down to Level 1.

nodes.name: Level 1 Mine Entrance
nodes.customNotes: The foot of the main timber adit descending from the surface quarry. Sputtering tallow torches line the rock ceiling, illuminating heavy timber shoring holding back loose schist.

nodes.name: Upper Ore Rail Junction
nodes.customNotes: Central ore cart turntable where miners haul rock carts to the surface lift. Piles of slag and discarded iron chisels show severe pitting and acid erosion.

nodes.name: Abandoned Western Drift
nodes.customNotes: Unworked blind drift where miners stored timber props. Scurrying sounds echo from cracks in the wall, where diseased rats gnaw at leather supply sacks.

nodes.name: Miner Dink's Excavation Post
nodes.customNotes: A dimly lit timber shelter where Miner Dink hunkers with a guttering oil lamp. He pleads for travelers to deliver a spare pickaxe down to Kylee on the second level.

nodes.name: Descent Shaft to Level 2
nodes.customNotes: A steep descending tunnel following narrow ore tracks down into the humid second level of the mine. Brackish water pools along the tunnel floor.

nodes.name: Ascent Incline to Level 1
nodes.customNotes: The sloping stone incline leading back up to Level 1. Water trickles down the carved drainage gutters along the eastern wall.

nodes.name: Flooded Sump & Timber Causeway
nodes.customNotes: A subterranean reservoir of murky greenish water bridged by slippery wooden planks. The stench of copper sludge and sulfur is overpowering.

nodes.name: Miner Kylee's Drift
nodes.customNotes: A spacious excavated pocket where Miner Kylee toils frantically. Terrified of kobold snipers in the dark, he accepts Dink's pickaxe with relief and whispers of armed 'little demons' running the lower shafts.

nodes.name: Upper Ventilation Drift
nodes.customNotes: Narrow twisting drift where stale air is drawn toward natural chimneys in the rock. Crude wooden caltrops and tripwires suggest kobolds have begun fortifying the level.

nodes.name: Descent Chute to Level 3
nodes.customNotes: A rough-hewn bore plunging into the kobold-infested third level. The distinct scent of burnt pine pitch and kobold dung rises from below.

nodes.name: Upper Incline from Level 2
nodes.customNotes: The bottom of the rocky passage descending from Level 2. The air here is dry and acrid with chimney smoke from crude kobold firepits.

nodes.name: Joseph's Remains & Lost Ring Alcove
nodes.customNotes: A shadowed hollow just below the upper entry where the unfortunate miner Joseph fell during the initial invasion. His skeletal hand still wears a greenstone signet ring bearing his family crest.

nodes.name: Chasm Suspension Bridge & Kobold Traps
nodes.customNotes: A creaking hemp rope bridge spanning a yawning subterranean fissure. Kobold Commandos have notched the timber supports and rigged wire-drawn spring traps loaded with fire darts.

nodes.name: Lower Kobold Encampment
nodes.customNotes: A sprawling warren reeking of kerosene, wet scales, and charred cave mushrooms. Swarms of kobold skirmishers and giant cave spiders guard the central tunnels.

nodes.name: Descent to Lair (Level 4)
nodes.customNotes: A grand subterranean archway reinforced with ancient stonework leading down into the sacred subterranean cavern of Cyric.

nodes.name: Subterranean Incline from Level 3
nodes.customNotes: The wet subterranean approach carved through black schist. Water sloshes along the narrow stone ledges flanked by glowing phosphor fungus.

nodes.name: Sanctum Approach & Xan's Prison Cell
nodes.customNotes: A barred alcove overlooking the central cavern where the melancholic elven sorcerer Xan is bound in iron shackles. He warns of certain doom and laments the theft of his Moonblade.

nodes.name: Mulahey's Desecrated Shrine & Sanctum
nodes.customNotes: A natural island cavern surrounded by subterranean waters, converted into a shrine to Cyric. The priest Mulahey directs the poison operations here with a chest full of Iron Throne correspondence.

nodes.name: Underground Lake Shore
nodes.customNotes: A slippery calcite terrace bordering the underground lake. Subterranean oozes and cave lizards nest among discarded mining helmets and half-eaten rations.

nodes.name: Valley Chute / Cloud Peak Surface Exit
nodes.customNotes: A natural drainage cleft through the eastern rock wall bathed in crisp outside sunlight. The tunnel empties onto the steep scree slopes of the eastern Cloud Peaks.

npcs.name: Mayor Berrun Ghastkill
npcs.motivation: Quell civilian unrest and halt the iron rot by securing dependable mercenaries to clear the deep mine adits.

secretsKnown.secret: Amnian military high command suspects the iron crisis is deliberate economic sabotage orchestrated by an offshore shadow syndicate rather than natural ore failure.

leverage.vulnerability: Terrified of rioting miners burning down the town hall if another shift vanishes in the shafts.
leverage.bribe: Delivery of solid proof explaining the tainted ore or Mulahey's death warrant.

dialogueHooks: Citizens! Hold your peace! If you are sellswords seeking honest bounty, step forward—Nashkel pays 900 gold to anyone who ends the horror in our mines!

relationships.notes: Agreed to harbor Minsc provided town scouts look for Dynaheir.
Desperately hunting for the identity of the monster sabotaging his mining settlement.

npcs.name: Minsc & Boo
npcs.role: Rashemi Berserker & Miniature Giant Space Hamster
npcs.motivation: Rescue his witch Dynaheir from the gnoll stronghold in the western mountains before harm befalls her.

secretsKnown.secret: Edwin approached him earlier attempting to hire him to assassinate Dynaheir, which Minsc was too trusting to fully comprehend at the time.

leverage.vulnerability: Any threat or insult directed at his pet hamster Boo drives him into an uncontrollable blood rage.
leverage.bribe: A solemn promise to march west immediately to free Dynaheir from the gnolls.

dialogueHooks: Go for the eyes, Boo! GO FOR THE EYES! Rask! Swords for everyone! Have you seen my Dynaheir?

relationships.notes: Fierce enmity; Edwin seeks the death of the very witch Minsc is sworn by honor to defend.
Indebted to town administration for aid in locating Dynaheir.

npcs.name: Edwin Odesseiron
npcs.motivation: Locate and execute the Wychlaran Dynaheir to satisfy his commission from the Red Wizards of Thay.

secretsKnown.secret: He carries scrolls detailing secret Iron Throne logistics shipments moving through the Cloakwood.

leverage.vulnerability: Towering arrogance coupled with mortal terror of being exposed as an uninvited Thayvian spy to the Amnian garrison.
leverage.bribe: Offer to escort him to the Gnoll Stronghold and assist in slaying Dynaheir.

dialogueHooks: You there! You possess the bearing of competent killers—or at least the intellect of well-trained mules. I have need of sellswords.

relationships.notes: Despises the hulking barbarian and plots to have him murdered along the road.

npcs.name: Prism the Sculptor
npcs.motivation: Complete his masterwork sculpture of Ellesime in the mountain rock before the bounty hunter Greywolf catches and murders him.

secretsKnown.secret: He stole two massive emeralds from the Amnian treasury to serve as the eyes for his sculpture.

leverage.vulnerability: Terminal exhaustion; he cannot survive a direct martial assault.
leverage.bribe: Standing guard over the clearing until the final chisel stroke is completed.

dialogueHooks: Just a few more strikes of the chisel... let me finish her face! Don't let Greywolf take my hands before she breathes!

relationships.notes: Hunted relentlessly by Greywolf for the stolen emeralds.

npcs.name: Greywolf
npcs.motivation: Execute Prism, claim the stolen emerald bounty, and slaughter anyone who intervenes.

secretsKnown.secret: He is privately employed by the Iron Throne to silence artisans who witnessed illicit ore transfers in the quarry.

leverage.vulnerability: Tunnel-vision bloodlust that makes him susceptible to ranged kiting and magical sleep.
leverage.bribe: Surrendering Prism and the emeralds without drawing a blade.

dialogueHooks: Step aside, whelps. Prism dies today, and if you draw steel, you will feed the mountain crows alongside him.

relationships.notes: Tracking Prism to collect the dead-or-alive bounty.

npcs.name: Miner Dink
npcs.motivation: Deliver fresh tools to Kylee in the lower sump while avoiding the strange noises echoing from the lower drifts.

secretsKnown.secret: Miners noticed that newly forged pickaxes crumble within hours because the smelted ore is contaminated at the source.

leverage.vulnerability: Mortal fear of subterranean cave-ins.
leverage.bribe: Offering to carry his spare pickaxe down to Kylee on Level 2.

dialogueHooks: Hey there! You look like you can handle yourself. If you're heading down to Level 2, could you take this pickaxe to Kylee? He's been screaming for it all morning!

relationships.notes: Fellow hard-rock miner and shift partner.

npcs.name: Miner Kylee
npcs.motivation: Survive the terrifying demonic screams and kobold raids plaguing the flooded galleries.

secretsKnown.secret: Little yipping dog-faced creatures with fire arrows have established fortified warrens on Level 3.

leverage.vulnerability: Isolation and dwindling rations in the damp sump.
leverage.bribe: Delivering Dink's fresh pickaxe.

dialogueHooks: Keep back! Oh... you're not one of those little reptilian bastards! Did Dink send that pickaxe? Thank Helm! Tell me you're here to clear the shafts!

relationships.notes: Relies on Dink to send tools and fresh oil down from the surface.

npcs.name: Mulahey the Unholy
npcs.motivation: Poison the iron vein with alchemical solvent while raising an army of kobolds and undead to cripple the Sword Coast.

secretsKnown.secret: He answers to the mysterious Tazok and the bandit alliance operating out of the Larswood and Cloakwood.

leverage.vulnerability: Spineless cowardice when cornered; will feign surrender and surrender his chest keys before summoning his skeletal cohort.
leverage.bribe: Will offer 790 gold from his locked coffer to be allowed to slip away into the dark.

dialogueHooks: I surrender! Hold! Tazok forced me! Look, take my letters and chest key... SKELETONS, KOBOLDS, HEAR YOUR MASTER—KILL THEM!

relationships.notes: Keeps Xan imprisoned in the outer chamber as a prize, confiscating his elven blade.
Derives sadistic pleasure from watching Ghastkill's town slowly disintegrate.

npcs.name: Xan
npcs.motivation: Recover his heirloom Moonblade from Mulahey's chest and survive what he believes is an inevitably doomed mission.

secretsKnown.secret: Mulahey receives couriers carrying encoded letters stamped with the signet of the Iron Throne.

leverage.vulnerability: Debilitating existential fatalism; requires decisive leadership to maintain his will to fight.
leverage.bribe: Reclaiming and returning his Moonblade to his hands.

dialogueHooks: We are all doomed, you know. Why you bothered descending into this stinking pit just to die alongside me is beyond comprehension.

relationships.notes: Bound and held captive by Mulahey's kobolds.

quests.title: Purge the Nashkel Mines
quests.notes: Mayor Berrun Ghastkill commissions the party to enter the Nashkel Mines, track down whatever force is slaughtering miners and poisoning the ore, and restore economic life to the settlement. Descend through all four subterranean levels, eliminate the Cyricist priest Mulahey, and recover the correspondence linking the sabotage to the Iron Throne. Success awards 900 gold, +1 Reputation, and lifts the regional iron scarcity.

quests.title: Miner Dink's Errand
quests.notes: Miner Dink on Level 1 requests delivery of a fresh mining pick down to Kylee working in the damp galleries on Level 2.

quests.title: Joseph's Greenstone Ring
quests.notes: Recover the engraved greenstone ring from the body of the fallen miner Joseph in the Kobold Warrens of Level 3 to return to his grieving widow in Nashkel.

quests.title: Prism's Final Masterpiece
quests.notes: Locate the fugitive sculptor Prism in the upper quarry. The bounty hunter Greywolf arrives to execute him for the theft of two emeralds. Slay Greywolf to allow Prism to place the emeralds into the statue's eyes and finish his masterpiece before collapsing from exhaustion. The emeralds can then be returned to Officer Oublek for bounty or kept for trade.

quests.title: The Wychlaran of Rashemen
quests.notes: Minsc begs the party to travel west to the Gnoll Stronghold to rescue his companion Dynaheir from the beast pens. Conversely, Edwin offers coin and arcane favor to locate and execute her. Taking too long to resolve the journey will cause Minsc to berserk and attack the party.

items.name: Varscona +2 (Long Sword of Cold)
items.specs: Enchanted steel longsword radiating glacial mist (+2 to hit and damage, +1 point of elemental cold damage on hit).
items.notes: The signature blade carried by the bounty hunter Greywolf, claimed as prize after his defeat.

items.name: Xan's Elven Moonblade
items.specs: Ancient Evereskan blade crackling with azure fire (+3 to hit, +1 AC bonus, usable exclusively by elves of lawful neutral alignment).
items.notes: Locked inside Mulahey's personal strongbox on Level 4; returning it restores Xan's combat capabilities.

items.name: Joseph's Greenstone Ring
items.specs: Engraved copper signet band set with cloudy green malachite.
items.notes: Found on the body of Joseph in the upper drifts of Level 3; brings peace and closure to his widow in town.

items.name: Chitinous Ankheg Plate Mail
items.specs: Masterwork carapace full plate (Armor Class 1, weight 25 lbs, highly resistant to corrosion).
items.notes: Buried in a hole in the dirt along the western crop fields of Nashkel; unowned environmental cache impervious to the regional iron rot.

items.name: Mulahey's Incriminating Dispatches
items.specs: Sealed missives stamped with the crest of a clenched fist clutching iron coins.
items.notes: Directly links the sabotage of the Nashkel Mines to the bandit leader Tazok and the Iron Throne syndicate.

items.name: Flawless Amnian Emeralds (Pair)
items.specs: Two fist-sized gems of pure viridian clarity (valued at 1,000 gold each).
items.notes: Stolen by Prism from the Amnian mint to complete the eyes of his stone masterpiece.

items.name: Blood-Stained Holy Symbol of Cyric
items.specs: Cast iron jawbone medallion dripping unholy residue (+1 to spell save DCs for evil clerics).
items.notes: Worn by Mulahey; serves as conclusive proof of his demise for Mayor Ghastkill.

factions.name: Amnian Council & Town Watch
factions.description: Mayor Ghastkill's municipal administration, garrison soldiers under Captain Bardolan, and the clergy of Helm.
factions.notes: Desperate to restore the flow of sound iron to prevent economic sanctions and rioting across the province.

factions.name: The Iron Throne & Sarevok's Conspiracy
factions.description: A merchant syndicate operating through shadow brokers, Cyricist death cultists, and kobold mercenaries.
factions.notes: Actively poisoning all regional iron supplies to drive the Sword Coast into war while hoarding untainted ore in Cloakwood.

factions.name: Unaligned Adventurers
factions.description: Fugitive artists, Rashemi berserkers, displaced miners, and visiting sellswords caught in the regional collapse.
factions.notes: Pursuing individual honor, artistic vision, or simple survival amid the crumbling borderlands.

trackers.name: Regional Iron Degradation & Civil Unrest
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick each time the party rests at the inn, when non-magical iron weapons shatter on a critical miss, or when mine expeditions fail. At 6 ticks, the miners revolt, torquing the town into martial law and closing the general store.

trackers.name: Minsc's Patience for Dynaheir
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick every two full days the party spends on other tasks without marching toward the Gnoll Stronghold after recruiting Minsc. At 4 ticks, Minsc flies into an uncontrollable frenzy, leaving the party and attacking anyone nearby.

trackers.name: Kobold Commando Ambush Preparedness
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick each time combat breaks out on Levels 1, 2, or 3. At 4 ticks, the commandos light fire arrows, coating the wooden walkway with blazing oil and triggering an ambush.

npcs.name: Miner Kylee

secretsKnown.secret: Little yipping dog-faced creatures with fire arrows have established fortified warrens on Level 3.

npcs.name: Mulahey the Unholy
npcs.motivation: Poison the iron vein with alchemical solvent while raising an army of kobolds and undead to cripple the Sword Coast.

secretsKnown.secret: He answers to the mysterious Tazok and the bandit alliance operating out of the Larswood and Cloakwood.

leverage.vulnerability: Spineless cowardice when cornered; will feign surrender and surrender his chest keys before summoning his skeletal cohort.
leverage.bribe: Will offer 790 gold from his locked coffer to be allowed to slip away into the dark.

dialogueHooks: I surrender! Hold! Tazok forced me! Look, take my letters and chest key... SKELETONS, KOBOLDS, HEAR YOUR MASTER—KILL THEM!

relationships.notes: Keeps Xan imprisoned in the outer chamber as a prize, confiscating his elven blade.
Derives sadistic pleasure from watching Ghastkill's town slowly disintegrate.

npcs.name: Xan
npcs.motivation: Recover his heirloom Moonblade from Mulahey's chest and survive what he believes is an inevitably doomed mission.

secretsKnown.secret: Mulahey receives couriers carrying encoded letters stamped with the signet of the Iron Throne.

leverage.vulnerability: Debilitating existential fatalism; requires decisive leadership to maintain his will to fight.
leverage.bribe: Reclaiming and returning his Moonblade to his hands.

dialogueHooks: We are all doomed, you know. Why you bothered descending into this stinking pit just to die alongside me is beyond comprehension.

relationships.notes: Bound and held captive by Mulahey's kobolds.

quests.title: Purge the Nashkel Mines
quests.notes: Mayor Berrun Ghastkill commissions the party to enter the Nashkel Mines, track down whatever force is slaughtering miners and poisoning the ore, and restore economic life to the settlement. Descend through all four subterranean levels, eliminate the Cyricist priest Mulahey, and recover the correspondence linking the sabotage to the Iron Throne. Success awards 900 gold, +1 Reputation, and lifts the regional iron scarcity.

quests.title: Miner Dink's Errand
quests.notes: Miner Dink on Level 1 requests delivery of a fresh mining pick down to Kylee working in the damp galleries on Level 2.

quests.title: Joseph's Greenstone Ring
quests.notes: Recover the engraved greenstone ring from the body of the fallen miner Joseph in the Kobold Warrens of Level 3 to return to his grieving widow in Nashkel.

quests.title: Prism's Final Masterpiece
quests.notes: Locate the fugitive sculptor Prism in the upper quarry. The bounty hunter Greywolf arrives to execute him for the theft of two emeralds. Slay Greywolf to allow Prism to place the emeralds into the statue's eyes and finish his masterpiece before collapsing from exhaustion. The emeralds can then be returned to Officer Oublek for bounty or kept for trade.

quests.title: The Wychlaran of Rashemen
quests.notes: Minsc begs the party to travel west to the Gnoll Stronghold to rescue his companion Dynaheir from the beast pens. Conversely, Edwin offers coin and arcane favor to locate and execute her. Taking too long to resolve the journey will cause Minsc to berserk and attack the party.

items.name: Varscona +2 (Long Sword of Cold)
items.specs: Enchanted steel longsword radiating glacial mist (+2 to hit and damage, +1 point of elemental cold damage on hit).
items.notes: The signature blade carried by the bounty hunter Greywolf, claimed as prize after his defeat.

items.name: Xan's Elven Moonblade
items.specs: Ancient Evereskan blade crackling with azure fire (+3 to hit, +1 AC bonus, usable exclusively by elves of lawful neutral alignment).
items.notes: Locked inside Mulahey's personal strongbox on Level 4; returning it restores Xan's combat capabilities.

items.name: Joseph's Greenstone Ring
items.specs: Engraved copper signet band set with cloudy green malachite.
items.notes: Found on the body of Joseph in the upper drifts of Level 3; brings peace and closure to his widow in town.

items.name: Chitinous Ankheg Plate Mail
items.specs: Masterwork carapace full plate (Armor Class 1, weight 25 lbs, highly resistant to corrosion).
items.notes: Buried in a hole in the dirt along the western crop fields of Nashkel; unowned environmental cache impervious to the regional iron rot.

items.name: Mulahey's Incriminating Dispatches
items.specs: Sealed missives stamped with the crest of a clenched fist clutching iron coins.
items.notes: Directly links the sabotage of the Nashkel Mines to the bandit leader Tazok and the Iron Throne syndicate.

items.name: Flawless Amnian Emeralds (Pair)
items.specs: Two fist-sized gems of pure viridian clarity (valued at 1,000 gold each).
items.notes: Stolen by Prism from the Amnian mint to complete the eyes of his stone masterpiece.

items.name: Blood-Stained Holy Symbol of Cyric
items.specs: Cast iron jawbone medallion dripping unholy residue (+1 to spell save DCs for evil clerics).
items.notes: Worn by Mulahey; serves as conclusive proof of his demise for Mayor Ghastkill.

trackers.name: Regional Iron Degradation & Civil Unrest
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick each time the party rests at the inn, when non-magical iron weapons shatter on a critical miss, or when mine expeditions fail. At 6 ticks, the miners revolt, torquing the town into martial law and closing the general store.

trackers.name: Minsc's Patience for Dynaheir
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick every two full days the party spends on other tasks without marching toward the Gnoll Stronghold after recruiting Minsc. At 4 ticks, Minsc flies into an uncontrollable frenzy, leaving the party and attacking anyone nearby.

trackers.name: Kobold Commando Ambush Preparedness
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick each time combat breaks out on Levels 1, 2, or 3. At 4 ticks, the commandos light fire arrows, coating the wooden walkway with blazing oil and triggering an ambush.

factions.name: Amnian Council & Town Watch
factions.description: Mayor Ghastkill's municipal administration, garrison soldiers under Captain Bardolan, and the clergy of Helm.
factions.notes: Desperate to restore the flow of sound iron to prevent economic sanctions and rioting across the province.

factions.name: The Iron Throne & Sarevok's Conspiracy
factions.description: A merchant syndicate operating through shadow brokers, Cyricist death cultists, and kobold mercenaries.
factions.notes: Actively poisoning all regional iron supplies to drive the Sword Coast into war while hoarding untainted ore in Cloakwood.

factions.name: Unaligned Adventurers
factions.description: Fugitive artists, Rashemi berserkers, displaced miners, and visiting sellswords caught in the regional collapse.
factions.notes: Pursuing individual honor, artistic vision, or simple survival amid the crumbling borderlands.

nodes.name: Township of Nashkel
nodes.customNotes: A rustic frontier town nestled against the Cloud Peaks. Red banners of Amn hang from the garrison walls, but the streets are tense. Blacksmiths examine rusted daggers with despair while bounty hunters linger outside the inn doors.

nodes.name: North Nashkel Road & Farmland
nodes.customNotes: Rutted dirt highway flanked by dry wheat fields and irrigation trenches. An upturned cart sits abandoned near an eastern furrow where an Ankheg shell lies partially buried in the mud.

nodes.name: Great Cloud Peak Waterfall & Pass
nodes.customNotes: A deafening mountain cascade carving through sheer granite bluffs toward the carnival grounds. Stray winter wolves and gibberlings stalk the mist-slick ledges.

nodes.name: Nashkel Carnival Encampment
nodes.customNotes: Vibrant striped pavilion tents, fortune tellers, games of chance, and exotic animal cages providing a garish distraction from the regional economic collapse.

nodes.name: Upper Quarry & Sculpture Clearing
nodes.customNotes: A sun-baked limestone amphitheater littered with shattered marble blocks. The sculptor Prism feverishly carves the likeness of Queen Ellesime into a granite cliff-face while dreading the bounty hunter Greywolf.

nodes.name: Nashkel Mines Surface Camp
nodes.customNotes: The palisaded surface works of the iron mine. Ore carts sit idle, guarded by weary Amnian soldiers with bloodhounds. A gaping timber-reinforced adit leads down into pitch-black subterranean shafts.

npcs.name: Mulahey the Unholy
npcs.motivation: Poison the iron vein with alchemical solvent while raising an army of kobolds and undead to cripple the Sword Coast.

secretsKnown.secret: He answers to the mysterious Tazok and the bandit alliance operating out of the Larswood and Cloakwood.

leverage.vulnerability: Spineless cowardice when cornered; will feign surrender and surrender his chest keys before summoning his skeletal cohort.
leverage.bribe: Will offer 790 gold from his locked coffer to be allowed to slip away into the dark.

dialogueHooks: I surrender! Hold! Tazok forced me! Look, take my letters and chest key... SKELETONS, KOBOLDS, HEAR YOUR MASTER—KILL THEM!

relationships.notes: Keeps Xan imprisoned in the outer chamber as a prize, confiscating his elven blade.
Derives sadistic pleasure from watching Ghastkill's town slowly disintegrate.

npcs.name: Xan
npcs.motivation: Recover his heirloom Moonblade from Mulahey's chest and survive what he believes is an inevitably doomed mission.

secretsKnown.secret: Mulahey receives couriers carrying encoded letters stamped with the signet of the Iron Throne.

leverage.vulnerability: Debilitating existential fatalism; requires decisive leadership to maintain his will to fight.
leverage.bribe: Reclaiming and returning his Moonblade to his hands.

dialogueHooks: We are all doomed, you know. Why you bothered descending into this stinking pit just to die alongside me is beyond comprehension.

relationships.notes: Bound and held captive by Mulahey's kobolds.

quests.title: Purge the Nashkel Mines
quests.notes: Mayor Berrun Ghastkill commissions the party to enter the Nashkel Mines, track down whatever force is slaughtering miners and poisoning the ore, and restore economic life to the settlement. Descend through all four subterranean levels, eliminate the Cyricist priest Mulahey, and recover the correspondence linking the sabotage to the Iron Throne. Success awards 900 gold, +1 Reputation, and lifts the regional iron scarcity.

quests.title: Miner Dink's Errand
quests.notes: Miner Dink on Level 1 requests delivery of a fresh mining pick down to Kylee working in the damp galleries on Level 2.

quests.title: Joseph's Greenstone Ring
quests.notes: Recover the engraved greenstone ring from the body of the fallen miner Joseph in the Kobold Warrens of Level 3 to return to his grieving widow in Nashkel.

quests.title: Prism's Final Masterpiece
quests.notes: Locate the fugitive sculptor Prism in the upper quarry. The bounty hunter Greywolf arrives to execute him for the theft of two emeralds. Slay Greywolf to allow Prism to place the emeralds into the statue's eyes and finish his masterpiece before collapsing from exhaustion. The emeralds can then be returned to Officer Oublek for bounty or kept for trade.

quests.title: The Wychlaran of Rashemen
quests.notes: Minsc begs the party to travel west to the Gnoll Stronghold to rescue his companion Dynaheir from the beast pens. Conversely, Edwin offers coin and arcane favor to locate and execute her. Taking too long to resolve the journey will cause Minsc to berserk and attack the party.

items.name: Varscona +2 (Long Sword of Cold)
items.specs: Enchanted steel longsword radiating glacial mist (+2 to hit and damage, +1 point of elemental cold damage on hit).
items.notes: The signature blade carried by the bounty hunter Greywolf, claimed as prize after his defeat.

items.name: Xan's Elven Moonblade
items.specs: Ancient Evereskan blade crackling with azure fire (+3 to hit, +1 AC bonus, usable exclusively by elves of lawful neutral alignment).
items.notes: Locked inside Mulahey's personal strongbox on Level 4; returning it restores Xan's combat capabilities.

items.name: Joseph's Greenstone Ring
items.specs: Engraved copper signet band set with cloudy green malachite.
items.notes: Found on the body of Joseph in the upper drifts of Level 3; brings peace and closure to his widow in town.

items.name: Chitinous Ankheg Plate Mail
items.specs: Masterwork carapace full plate (Armor Class 1, weight 25 lbs, highly resistant to corrosion).
items.notes: Buried in a hole in the dirt along the western crop fields of Nashkel; unowned environmental cache impervious to the regional iron rot.

items.name: Mulahey's Incriminating Dispatches
items.specs: Sealed missives stamped with the crest of a clenched fist clutching iron coins.
items.notes: Directly links the sabotage of the Nashkel Mines to the bandit leader Tazok and the Iron Throne syndicate.

items.name: Flawless Amnian Emeralds (Pair)
items.specs: Two fist-sized gems of pure viridian clarity (valued at 1,000 gold each).
items.notes: Stolen by Prism from the Amnian mint to complete the eyes of his stone masterpiece.

items.name: Blood-Stained Holy Symbol of Cyric
items.specs: Cast iron jawbone medallion dripping unholy residue (+1 to spell save DCs for evil clerics).
items.notes: Worn by Mulahey; serves as conclusive proof of his demise for Mayor Ghastkill.

trackers.name: Regional Iron Degradation & Civil Unrest
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick each time the party rests at the inn, when non-magical iron weapons shatter on a critical miss, or when mine expeditions fail. At 6 ticks, the miners revolt, torquing the town into martial law and closing the general store.

trackers.name: Minsc's Patience for Dynaheir
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick every two full days the party spends on other tasks without marching toward the Gnoll Stronghold after recruiting Minsc. At 4 ticks, Minsc flies into an uncontrollable frenzy, leaving the party and attacking anyone nearby.

trackers.name: Kobold Commando Ambush Preparedness
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick each time combat breaks out on Levels 1, 2, or 3. At 4 ticks, the commandos light fire arrows, coating the wooden walkway with blazing oil and triggering an ambush.
